organization.name: NexaLink Communications
organization.description: NexaLink Communications is a mid-tier telecommunications provider offering mobile voice and data plans, home broadband, enterprise fiber solutions, and IPTV streaming packages to over 4.2 million subscribers across 29 states. The company is known for its aggressive 5G rollout program and its NexaCloud unified communications platform aimed at small and medium-sized businesses.

product_catalog.name: NexaMobile Lite
product_catalog.description: Prepaid mobile plan with 5 GB data, unlimited SMS, and 200 minutes of voice calls per month.

product_catalog.name: NexaMobile Unlimited
product_catalog.description: Postpaid unlimited voice, SMS, and data plan with 30 GB high-speed 5G data before throttling.

product_catalog.name: NexaMobile Family Pack
product_catalog.description: Shared postpaid plan for up to 5 lines with 25 GB high-speed data per line and international roaming add-ons.

product_catalog.name: NexaFiber Home 300
product_catalog.description: Residential fiber-optic internet with symmetrical 300 Mbps download and upload speeds.

product_catalog.name: NexaFiber Home 1Gig
product_catalog.description: Residential fiber-optic internet with symmetrical 1 Gbps speeds, ideal for smart homes and remote workers.

product_catalog.name: NexaStream TV
product_catalog.description: IPTV service with 180+ live channels, cloud DVR (500 GB), and on-demand library of 10,000+ titles.

product_catalog.name: NexaBundle Home+
product_catalog.description: Bundled package combining NexaFiber Home 300 + NexaStream TV at a discounted rate.

product_catalog.name: NexaCloud SMB
product_catalog.description: Unified communications platform for SMBs including VoIP PBX, video conferencing, team messaging, and cloud storage up to 2 TB.

product_catalog.name: NexaFiber Enterprise
product_catalog.description: Dedicated fiber internet for businesses with SLA-backed 99.99% uptime, static IPs, and 24/7 priority support.

product_catalog.name: NexaRoam Global Pass
product_catalog.description: International roaming add-on providing voice, SMS, and 5 GB data in 80+ countries at no extra per-usage charge.

product_catalog.name: NexaShield Security Suite
product_catalog.description: Mobile and home network security suite with real-time threat detection, VPN, parental controls, and identity monitoring for up to 10 devices.

product_catalog.name: NexaDevice Hub
product_catalog.description: NexaLink-branded Wi-Fi 6E mesh router system (3-node) sold or leased to residential broadband subscribers for whole-home coverage.
